title: Substrate-Dependent Oxygen Evolution Performance of Electrodeposited CoNiFe Layered Double Hydroxide: Nickel Fiber Film as an Optimal Support
authors: Ar Rafi Ferdous, Abdulmajid A. Mirghni, Syed Shaheen Shah, Md Delowar Hossain and Md. Abdul Aziz
abstract: Efficient alkaline water electrolysis requires earth-abundant oxygen evolution reaction (OER) electrocatalysts that combine low <mark>overpotential</mark>, rapid kinetics, and operational durability. Herein, trimetallic CoNiFe layered double hydroxide (LDH) was grown directly on nickel fiber film (NFF) by a simple one-step electrodeposition method and evaluated across multiple conductive substrates. The optimized CoNiFe LDH/NFF electrode delivered superior OER activity in 1.0 M KOH, requiring overpotentials of only 241 and 306 mV to reach 10 and 50 mA cm−2, respectively, with a Tafel slope of 66.15 mV dec−…
